☀Core♦Vocabulary Games◆Speech Practice■Parent & Admin

Every screen, every size, one board.

This isn't a mockup file — every frame below is a real screenshot of the running app, captured headlessly at three viewport widths (390 × 844 / 834 × 1112 / 1440 × 900) with realistic seeded data, so what you see here is exactly what ships. Organized the way the app itself is: the core tap-and-hear loop, the ten arcade-style vocabulary games, the six speech-practice activities grounded in real early-intervention technique, and the parent/admin surface behind the math-problem gate.
